messages:
Olivia H.: Opening a small PR to add a 'SampleGuard' section to the Optimize toolkit docs 1 quick checks teams should run when changing batching/caching/quant. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/12456

Samir P.: good idea. keep it short: 3 checks 1 correctness (sanity prompts), perf (mini harness), resource (mem/time).

Jae K.: suggest we include a tiny sanity prompt for quant changes that people can run locally, e.g. `compare_quality(model, prompt_list)` helper snippet.

Marta L.: also add an explicit guard for embeddings: 'if batch>32, run mem check on target instance'. keep examples conservative so CI passes.

Olivia H.: plan: one page with 3 bullets, 3 tiny code snippets (py sync, js batch-embeds, py perf harness call), and a YAML snippet for the CI smoke job that runs the examples with reduced inputs.

Samir P.: CI note: the smoke job should set env `DOCS_SMOKE=true` and use sample inputs to avoid hitting prod tokens.

DocsBot: PR #12456 CI started  doc-snippets + smoke.

DocsBot: CI: 1 failure  perf-smoke timed out (embed batch still slow). logs: https://ci.redwood/inference/12456/logs

Olivia H.: lowering embed batch in example to 16 and adding comment: "increase for production". also added a fallback note: `options: { cache_mode: \"off\" }` for small GPUs.

Jae K.: pushed a tiny edit to the Python quant sanity helper to print differences rather than assert, so it's safe for docs readers. sample:
`def compare_quality(model, prompts):
    for p in prompts:
        resp = client.generate(model=model, input=p, options={"quant_profile":"int8"})
        print(p[:80], resp.text[:120])`

Samir P.: reviewed perf note and added a short line about observed token-cost delta: int8 ~1.4x cost reduction vs fp16 on our small harness.

Marta L.: editorial nit: change heading from 'Checks' to 'SampleGuard checklist' and add the one-liner 'Use as a starting point, not a guarantee'.

Olivia H.: updated and merged at 2405001150  docs build queued. :sparkles:

Samir P.: follow-up  filing a tiny issue to add telemetry hooks to see which guard items users run.

DocsBot: Issue #4578 opened to track SampleGuard telemetry.

Marta L.: thanks everyone  this should reduce support noise. :thumbsup:
